mandates.thresholdNote: Phased in by contract value: contracts >= EUR 215,000 from 2022-11-01, >= EUR 30,000 from 2023-05-01, < EUR 30,000 from 2023-11-01. Contracts under EUR 3,000 are exempt.
mandates.notes: Legal basis: federal law of 7 April 2019, transposing Directive 2014/55/EU.

Legal basis: federal law amending the VAT code, dated 6 February 2024. Peppol BIS Billing 3.0 over the Peppol network is the default; an alternative format is permitted only by mutual agreement and only if convertible to EN 16931. Exemptions: VAT-exempt entities, foreign taxpayers with no Belgian permanent establishment, and certain intra-community/cross-border transactions.
